verse.verse_1: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
verse.verse_3: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,
verse.verse_4: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
verse.verse_7: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.
verse.verse_8: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,
verse.verse_9: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
verse.verse_10: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
verse.verse_11: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.
verse.verse_12: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
verse.verse_13: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,
verse.verse_14: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
verse.verse_15: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
verse.verse_17: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
verse.verse_18: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?
verse.verse_19: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
verse.verse_20: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.
verse.verse_21: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.
